narrative.northStar: The Polite Guest and the Spare Panel
keyCharacteristics: In-page UI borrows Spotify's palette and inherits Spotify's font (`font-family: inherit`).
Extension pages are the app's dark well: `bg-0` page, `bg-1` panels on hairline borders, mono labels and controls, sans prose.
Stroked line glyphs only (`fill: none`, `stroke: currentColor`, round caps); state is a glyph swap plus a colour.
Flat everywhere except the floating in-page layers (menu, toast, card disc), which lift with soft black shadows.

rules.name: The Two Worlds Rule
rules.body: Spotify's colours never appear on the extension pages, and the app's tokens never appear on open.spotify.com. The in-page CSS writes Spotify's values literally; the pages use only `page.css` custom properties.

rules.name: The Amber-Is-Focus-Only Rule
rules.body: On the extension pages `focus-ring` (amber) is the keyboard focus outline and nothing else. Status uses green and red dots. In the app, amber means live state, and the extension has no live state to show.

rules.name: The Mono Names, Sans Explains Rule
rules.body: If it's a label, a control or a value, set it in mono. If it's a sentence, set it in sans.

rules.name: The Topmost Layer Rule
rules.body: The menu and the toast sit at `z-index: 2147483647` so they stay above Spotify's own overlays, its cookie banner included. Nothing else in-page takes a z-index beyond the card icon's local `2`.
